reply.english: I don't know, but it's cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Mona
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير يا كريم، الجو إيه النهارده؟

dialogue.speaker: Mona
dialogue.arabic: وفيه هوا كتير بره؟

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: أيوه، الهوا جامد شوية
dialogue.english: Yes, the wind is a bit strong.

dialogue.speaker: Mona

dialogue.speaker: Mona

dialogue.speaker: Karim

dialogue.speaker: Mona

dialogue.english: Come on, see you after work.

response.english: May God make it a good thing.
Yes, you need to dress warmly.

lessons.culture: Cairenes open small talk with the weather and often say "ed-donya" instead of "el-gaww", as in "ed-donya 7arr". Rain is rare in Cairo, and when it comes people commonly say "rabbena yeg3elo kheer" (may God make it good).

dialogue.english: Yes, but the weather changes a lot between the seasons.

dialogue.arabic: صح، يوم حر ويوم برد

pair.english: What season are we in now?
Is summer long where you are?

lessons.culture: In Cairo summer is long and hot, so many families head to Alexandria or the North Coast for the sea. Snow is only seen on the mountains of Sinai, so winter in Cairo means cold nights and rain, not snow.

pair.english: Will it rain? Should I take an umbrella?

pair.arabic: إيه أكتر لون بتحبه في الجاكيتات؟
pair.english: What's your favorite color in jackets?

lessons.culture: In Cairo people dress for the day: cool mornings, a strong midday sun, and a chilly night in winter, so a light jacket is standard from autumn on. Winter rain is short but heavy and streets flood, which is why people take an umbrella ("shamsiyya") seriously.

response.english: If the weather's nice, why not.

pair.english: Shall we sit on the balcony tonight?

lessons.culture: Egyptians love evening outings and the balcony ("el-balakoona") is where many families sit on summer nights, so plans in Cairo shift to the evening when the day is too hot. "3ala 7asab el-gaww" (depending on the weather) is a common way to leave a plan open.

challenge.title: Plan Your Day Around the Weather
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Egyptian conversation, at least 10 lines, between two friends deciding what to do today based on the weather. It must include asking about the weather, describing it with at least two different weather words, a question about the season, advice on what to wear, and a decision on whether to go out or stay home.
required_elements: A question about the weather, using الجو إيه.
At least two different weather descriptions, such as حر, برد, مغيّم, or بتمطر.
A mention of the season, using a word like الصيف, الشتا, الربيع, or الخريف.
Advice on what to wear, using لازم تلبس or البس.
A condition using لو الجو حلو or لو الدنيا مطرت.
A reminder using لازم تاخد شمسية or خد شمسية معاك.
A final decision to go out (هنخرج) or stay home (هنقعد في البيت).

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير، الجو إيه النهارده؟
dialogue.english: Good morning, what's the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، الدنيا غيم شوية بس مش برد أوي
dialogue.transliteration: sabaa7 en-noor, ed-donya gheem shweyya bass mesh bard awi
dialogue.english: Good morning, it's a bit cloudy but not too cold.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: إحنا في الخريف صح؟ عشان كده ورق الشجر بيقع
dialogue.transliteration: e7na fel-khareef sa77? 3ashaan keda wara2 esh-shagar biy2a3
dialogue.english: We're in fall, right? That's why the leaves are falling.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: أيوه، والدنيا بتبرد بالليل في الموسم ده
dialogue.transliteration: aywa, wed-donya betebrad bel-leil fel-mawsim da
dialogue.english: Yes, and it gets cold at night in this season.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: شفت حالة الطقس؟ هتمطر؟
dialogue.english: Did you see the forecast? Will it rain?

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: يمكن بعد الضهر، خد شمسية معاك
dialogue.transliteration: yemken ba3d ed-dohr, khod shamsiyya ma3aak
dialogue.english: Maybe after noon, take an umbrella with you.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: طيب ألبس إيه؟
dialogue.english: Okay, what should I wear?

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: البسي جاكيت خفيف وحاجة مريحة
dialogue.english: Wear a light jacket and something comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: لو الجو حلو هنخرج نتمشى في الحديقة
dialogue.english: If the weather's nice we'll go for a walk in the park.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: ولو مطرت هنقعد في البيت
dialogue.english: And if it rains we'll stay home.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: اتفقنا، هنشوف الجو بعد الضهر
dialogue.english: Agreed, we'll see the weather after noon.
